title: King
desc: The heir to a large estate is killed by his conniving relatives. Meanwhile, his lookalike, a gangster, falls in love with a singer and impersonates a software engineer to impress her.

title: Ten Hours
desc: While searching for a missing girl, righteous police officer Castro stumbles upon a baffling homicide involving a passenger slain in total silence. He must rush to uncover the killer.

title: Aneethi
desc: Thirumeni, food delivery man with a mental disorder is known to kill people in their minds. During a delivery, he meets a maid and falls in love with her, but their lives take a twist.

title: Spyder
desc: Shiva, an intelligence officer, develops a phone software that helps him track those in need of help. He sets out to save the people of Hyderabad when he realises that a serial killer is on the loose.

title: Chakra Ka Rakshak
desc: A police officer and soldier team up and decide to end the cybercriminals that pose a threat to the safety of people on the Internet.

title: Main Hoon Yodha
desc: Due to some unfortunate circumstances, a medical student follows the path of crime. Trouble ensues when he turns out to be a Good Samaritan, proving to be an enemy of the mafia.

title: Vikram Vetal
desc: King Vikramaditya is told twenty-five stories by a ghost, Vetal. He must find a moral lesson in each of these stories.

title: Teleshopping
desc: Learn about a wide selection of products and take advantage of a convenient method of shopping. A show for those who love to shop from the comforts of their home.

title: Meri Izzat
desc: Due to misunderstandings and their daughter's untimely death, a woman deserts her husband. Years later, he is puzzled to see his daughter's lookalike and tries to develop a bond with her.

title: Tamilarasan
desc: A police officer takes control of a hospital after his son is neglected for providing a heart transplant. The conflict soon arises when he refuses to follow his senior's order.

title: Fillers
desc: A comprehensive compilation of promotional videos and trailers of Bollywood movies featuring popular actors and actresses.
